definitions.explanation: Assistance provided to help or protect someone, originally military (covering fire) but now widely used figuratively to mean backing someone up or providing support.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{援護|えんご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{味方|みかた}→味方：03743_mikata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{援護|えんご}⟦{射撃|しゃげき}→射撃：16089_shageki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{前進|ぜんしん}→前進：03758_zenshin⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We were able to advance thanks to covering fire from our allies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{援護|えんご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ。
examples.english: My opinion was accepted at the meeting because my senior colleague backed me up.

notes:
A compound of {援|えん} (aid) and {護|ご} (protect). Originally a military term for providing covering fire or protective support, now commonly used figuratively in everyday and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {援護|えんご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to provide support, to back up
- {援護|えんご}⟦{射撃|しゃげき}→射撃：16089_shageki⟧ — covering fire
- {援護|えんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ — to seek support
- {戦傷病者|せんしょうびょうしゃ}⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧⟦{遺族|いぞく}→遺族：14886_izoku⟧{等|とう}{援護|えんご}{法|ほう} — war veterans' support law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧ — support, assistance (broader, more general)
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧ — cheering, support (encouraging someone)
- ⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧ — aid, assistance (material or financial help)
- ⟦{庇護|ひご}→庇護：12480_higo⟧ — protection, patronage (sheltering from harm)
